high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from the user "jamesgunn." The post features a photograph of an elderly woman with gray hair, smiling warmly at the camera. She is wearing a dark blue turtleneck sweater and a light-colored jacket with a fur-lined hood. The background shows an outdoor setting with trees and a red car partially visible. The text overlay on the image reads: "Rest in Peace, Ramona Fradon, the creator of Metamorpho. She passed away at the age of 97, after a long, beautiful life, an artist to the end. ❤️"
